body: EDP has been arrested on 4 felony counts, and will be extradited back to California after JiDion helped coordinate his arrest at EDP’s dialysis center. YouTuber Mike Clum’s documentary “The Sick Mind of EDP445” was reportedly used as evidence in the case against him. Allegations are not findings of guilt.
